verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a hosted incorporation service, and whether a software product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence shows Atlas source code being released under an open license. The Cooley-developed legal templates and the llms.txt or markdown docs probes are documentation access, not open-source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
